title: Movement
content:
Movement

Base movement component for entities.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "movement": {
    "speed": 5.0,
    "acceleration": 10.0
  }
}

Description

The Movement component is the base movement component for entities. It defines fundamental movement properties such as speed and acceleration that control how an entity moves through the game world.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
speedfloatThe movement speed of the entity.
accelerationfloatThe acceleration rate of the entity.

Example

JSON
{
  "movement": {
    "speed": 8.0,
    "acceleration": 15.0
  }
}
